zones.name: Adamsdown
zones.text: South Wales Police recorded 915 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — an average of 26.3 per 1,000 residents a month, the 2nd highest rate of Cardiff's 28 wards. The daytime score here is driven by vehicle crime (48), shoplifting (36), drugs (8); the evening/night score by violent crime (74), anti social behaviour (42), public order (33). Those two scores are split by offence type, not by clock time — the police feed records no time of day, so day and night here mean the kinds of crime typical of each, not counts of incidents observed then. Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.
